CanonAdditions: The city has been under the shadow of the Blight for three weeks.
The Blight is a corruption spreading through the world that creates a living fog and corrupts creatures into Blight-Touched entities.
Blight-Touched creatures are humanoid, too tall, too pale, with skin stretched taut over protruding bones, glowing sickly green eyes, and jerky unnatural gaits.
Blight-Touched creatures are highly resistant to physical damage but vulnerable to specific magical weaknesses and disruption.
The fog associated with the Blight reduces visibility to nearly zero within ten paces.
Sudden noises or quick movements in the Blight fog trigger attacks from lurking entities.
Kaelen's magic is fueled by the same energy that fuels the Blight.
WorldStateUpdates: The air in the city tastes of copper and rot.
Rain is falling heavily on the cobblestones of the ruined market square.
Scavengers still prowl the streets of the city.
The old temple district contains ruins and narrow passages.

Updates: Elias Thorne exists and is an established character.
Elias Thorne possesses a sword that is dull from disuse.
Elias Thorne knows the mechanics of the Blight fog danger better than anyone.
Elias Thorne is traveling with Kaelen.
Kaelen exists and is an established character.
Kaelen possesses a brass gauntlet on his wrist, which is a relic from an era before the Blight.
Kaelen has magical abilities, including summoning smoke and creating shields of light.
Kaelen's magic can cause the ground to shift and create fissures.

NarrativeStateUpdates: Elias Thorne and Kaelen are traveling through the ruined market square of the city.
Elias Thorne and Kaelen encountered two Blight-Touched creatures in the fog.
Kaelen was grazed by a claw during the encounter with the Blight-Touched creatures.
UnresolvedInformation: The specific identity of the three non-human figures Kaelen initially spotted is not resolved, as only two Blight-Touched creatures emerged from the fog.
The source of the dragging sound heard by Elias and Kaelen is not explicitly identified beyond being associated with the pursuing creatures.
